Commentary.Commentary: Hasan Ali was the standout bowler as he picked a fifer. Shadab Khan and the rest provided great support to him. The leg spinner also finished with two important wickets of Dinesh Chandimal and Upul Tharanga. The wicket is on the slower side but the home side will fancy themselves to chase this down. Sri Lanka will have to bowl really well if they are to win this game and level the series. Join us in a while for the chase.

Brilliant bowling effort by the hosts! This is the seventh time in a row Pakistan have managed to keep the opposition under 250! After winning the toss and electing to bat first, the tourists got off to a decent start but after the loss of Dickwella's wicket they could not surge a partnership. They kept losing wickets and also their batsmen found it difficult to rotate strike, especially Chandimal who played at a strike rate of 38.78. Upul Tharanga played a good knock and a cameo towards the end by Perera has helped them take the score above 200.

OUT! Perera has been run out in an attempt to retain strike. A very full delivery on middle, Perera drives it towards long on. He completes one and then goes for the second. Raees himself runs behind the ball, gets to it quickly and fires a throw to Sarfraz who collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. They appeal and the umpire refers it upstairs. Replays show that Perera is short of his crease. A good cameo by him comes to an end. SRI LANKA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 208!
A referral for a run out at the striker's end against Perera has been taken upstairs.

Slower ball outside off, Perera tries to go big but gets a top edge which goes towards covers. Imam-ul-Haq runs after it and puts in a desperate dive, gets a hand to it but cannot hold onto the chance. The batsmen take two.
Very full outside off, Gamage does well to keep it out. Hasan Ali finishes with career-best ODI figures, 10-0-34-5!
Lahiru Gamage is the last man in.

OUT! Fifer for Hasan Ali ! Take a bow young man! A brilliant bowling display by him. He takes it on the second last delivery of his spell. His third fifer. He comes steaming in and goes wide of the crease. Bangs it short outside off, gets it to jag back in. Chameera goes for the cut but it was too close for that shot. The ball takes the edge and goes to Sarfraz who makes no mistake.
Bouncer on middle, Chameera ducks under it.
Angles it into the batsman. Perera hits it down to long on for a run.
Fullish in length outside off, Perera swings at it but connects with thin air. That was close to the off pole.
Sensible stuff from Chameera. He taps the ball on off towards point for a quick single to get Perera on strike.

FOUR! Sloppy Zaman! Length ball around middle, Perera slogs it through mid-wicket and looks for a couple. Zaman in the deep though fumbles and allows the ball to go through for a boundary. Sarfraz is not happy, one bit.
FOUR! Hammered! Shorter again, Perera pulls it through mid-wicket for another boundary. He is getting Sri Lanka to the score they need.
Top edge! Shorter in length outside off, Perera goes for the pull. He gets a top edge over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Smashed! Shorter in length around middle, Thirimanne pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Works it through the leg side for a single.
Chameera tucks it towards mid-wicket.
WIDE! Slants it down the leg side, Chameera fails to clip it through.
Rumann Raees comes back on.
Full and outside off, pushed towards wide mid off for a single.
Another length ball around middle, Thisara cannot pull. Sarfraz fumbles and allows a bye.
Good length around middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a brace. Ahmed wants Ashraf to swap his place as he was too slow.
Slower short one outside off, Perera is beaten all ends up.
Short again on middle and leg, Chameera fails to pull it. The ball goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Shorter in length, angling into the body of the batsman, Perera pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Tries the reverse sweep again but this time also he hits it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! BRUTE! Thisara Perera comes down the track and hits the ball on off stump hard down the ground, past the diving fielder for a boundary.
Goes for the reverse sweep, he connects but straight to point.
WIDE! Fires this one down the leg side. Perera lets it through. The keeper also misses it and the batsmen run two byes. The umpire also signals a wide.

Perera comes down the track and Hafeez sees him doing so. He fires it wide outside off. Perera is smart as he lets the ball go and gets back into the crease. Good thinking from both, the batsman and the bowler.

NOT OUT! Perera has made it in time! Hafeez fires it on off, Chameera defends it towards covers and calls for a run. Perera obliges and sets off. The fielder is quick to the ball and fires a throw to the keeper who takes the bails off and appeals. They go upstairs and the replays show he is in. A run added to the total.
An appeal for run out at the striker's end against Perera has been taken upstairs.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Full outside off, right in the slot for Perera. He lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
Yorker on middle, Chameera digs it out on the off side for a run.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Edge and a boundary! The question here is why isn't there a second slip? Hasan Ali lands it on a length around off, Chameera pokes at it and gets an outside edge between the keeper and the slip fielder for a boundary.
Length ball on off, it jags back in. Chameera looks to defend but is beaten and the ball strikes him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Dushmantha Chameera walks out to the middle. A milestone for Hasan Ali, he is now the fastest bowler from Pakistan to take 50 ODI wickets beating Waqar Younis.

OUT! Hasan Ali has a four-fer! He is also the fastest Pakistan bowler to reach 50 ODI wickets beating Waqar Younis! Joint-fourth highest overall to the milestone. Coming to the ball, Ali comes from around the wicket and lands it on a length around off, shapes away after pitching. Dananjaya tries to defend but gets an outside edge to the keeper.
Hasan Ali is back into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Akila Dananjaya walks out to bat.

OUT! What an unfortunate way to get out! Thirimanne will be rueing his luck. Hafeez bowls an arm ball on off, Thirimanne goes for the drive and gets an inside edge which goes to Sarfraz who takes it. The Pakistan players appeal, Babar Azam is very interested and he wanted the umpires to take it upstairs and the umpires do so. Replays show it is not a bump ball and it has gone off the boot to the keeper and out is what flashes on the big screen. Thirimanne cannot believe his luck.
An appeal for a catch has been taken upstairs. The soft signal by the umpire is not out.

Fires it on the pads. Thisara flicks it through square leg for a run. Perera wants a second but is sent back by his partner.The fielder misses the stumps at the non-striker's end and Perera makes his ground. A direct hit would have been close.
Flicks it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up outside off. Thirimanne drives it to covers.
Drives once again through mid off for a run. Shadab finishes his spell with figures of 10/0/37/2 brilliant effort by him.
Loopy ball on off, very full so the turn is out of question. Perera drives it through long off for a run.
Fuller in length outside off. Thirimanne drives it down to long off for a run.
Flighted ball on off, Thisara flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Floats it up on off, turning back in. Perera defends it towards covers.
Flatter delivery on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
Short on middle, Thirimanne flicks it through mid on for a run.
Comes down the track and drives it to covers.
Drags his length back, Perera whips it through mid-wicket for a run.
Darts it on middle, it goes on with the arm. Perera misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. One run added to the total.
Powerplay 3 signaled. Five fielders are now allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Almost another one for Shadab! He bowls it quicker and flatter on off. Perera checkes his push and the ball goes uppishly but on the bounce to Shadab. That was just short of him.
The batsman drives this through the covers.
Flatter on off, Thirimanne defends it off the back foot.
Floats it full on middle, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
Floats it full on middle, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
A long hop but spins in sharply. Thirimanne goes back and tucks it around the corner for a run.
Fires it on the pads, Perera flicks it to short fine leg.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags his length back, the ball also stays low. Perera flicks it to mid-wicket.
Comes down the track and drives it down to long off for an easy run.
Gives it air on middle, Perera pushes it down through mid on for a run
Tosses it up on off, Thirimanne drives it down to long off for a run.
Mohammad Hafeez back into the attack. Spin from both ends.
Punches one towards point off his crease.
Flicks it with the spin through the leg side for a run.
Floats it full outside off, Thirimanne drives it towards mid off. The bowler dives to his right and makes a good stop of his own bowling.
A googly on middle. Thisara fails to pick it. He tries to work it on the leg side but gets a soft leading edge through mid off for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Thirimanne drives it down to long off for a run.
Leg spinner turning into the batsman. Thirimanne with the spin flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan is back into the attack.
Good length on off, Perera defends it towards point.
A slow, loopy bouncer on off. Thirimanne reads it well and guides it down to third man for a run. Only 7 runs have been scored of the last 23 balls.
Slower ball on off, Thirimanne waits for it and drives it to the man at covers.
Bangs it in short but outside off. Perera ducks under it.
Full again on off, Thisara pushes it towards mid off for a run.
Fuller in length on off, Perera eases it to mid off.
Lands it on a length around off, Thirimanne defends it off the back foot.
Fuller in length outside off, Lahiru drives it to the man at covers.
In walks Thisara Perera, not sure why he did not come in earlier.

OUT! Hasan strikes again! Shorter in length outside off, Vandersay looks to pull but gets hurried into it. The ball takes the top edge and goes towards short fine leg. Ahmed calls for it, gets under it and pouches it safely. Third wicket for Hasan Ali and Sri Lanka sink further. Last five overs have seen Sri Lanka lose 3 wickets for just 14 runs.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards point by the batsman.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
WIDE! Short but down the leg side. Vandersay leaves it and the umpire calls it a wide.
Full in length on off, Vandersay drives it to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
A huge appeal but turned down! A full inswinging yorker on leg stump. Thirimanne misses the flick and is hit on the boot. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Missing leg.
Jeffrey Vandersay strides out to bat.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Another failure for Siriwardana! A poor shot by him. Junaid bowls it a touch short on off, bends his back on this one. Bounces a touch more. Siriwardana goes for the pull but gets a top edge which lobs towards Zaman at mid-wicket who pedals back and takes a nice catch.
Back of a length on off, the batsman defends it.
Good length outside off, Thirimanne guides it down to third man for a run.
Full outside off, Siriwardana drives it through covers for a run.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.

Comes around the wicket and goes for the yorker. Again tried for a similar delivery on which he got him in the first game. This one did not swing and Siriwardana flicks it through square leg for a run.
Milinda Siriwardana strides out to the middle.

OUT! Hasan Ali is now the leading wicket-taker in 2017 in ODIs! A soft dismissal to be honest! He lands it on a length around off, the ball sticks into the surface and comes in after pitching, Kapugedera tries to flick but is early into the shot. He gets a leading edge which lobs back to the bowler who takes it easily. Ali gets his second and Sri Lanka are losing their way. Replays show that Kapugedera hit the ball twice. Once when he attempted the shot and next when the ball was going up in the air, he lobbed off the toe end of the bat.
Good length on off, jags back into the batsman. Chamara defends it off the back foot.
Good length outside off, Kapugedera drives it to point.
Lands it on a length on off, Thirimanne guides it down to third man for a run.
Length on off, defended off the front foot. Four from the over.
FOUR! A poor ball releases all the pressure! Short on middle, sits up to be hit. Kapugedera swivels inside the crease and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
Fuller in length. Driven to mid off.

Short ball on middle coming in with the angle, also stays low. Kapugedera tries to pull but is beaten by the low bounce and is struck on the thigh pad. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. Too high.
Good length on middle, the batsman defends it towards point. He wanted a run but was sent back by his partner as the fielder was quick to the ball.
On the shorter side again by Junaid but outside off. Kapugedera does well to evade it.
Short and on middle. Pulled hard by Kapugedera but straight to deep square leg for a run.
Short and wide outside off, stays a touch low. Thirimanne tries to cut but gets beaten.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Lahiru pushes it down to mid on for a quick run.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Gets the ball to swing away from the batsman. Thirimanne defends it solidly.
Lands it on a length on middle, Thirimanne shuffles across and flicks it against the angle through mid-wicket for a brace.
Good length on off, Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Hasan Ali is brought back into the attack.
Fuller this time, attacking the stumps. Kapugedera drives it to mid on.
Tries to surprise the batsman with a short ball. Thirimanne was ready for it as he pulls it through mid-wicket to get off strike.
Comes around the wicket and lands it on a length around off. Chamara quite easily guides it towards the third man region for a run.
A little width on offer outside off. Thirimanne opens his face of the bat and guides it towards third man for an easy single.
Lands it on a length on off, angling away from the batsman. Kapugedera guides it down to third man for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Thirimanne flicks it through square leg to rotate strike.
Junaid Khan is back into the attack.
Time for drinks!
Short and outside off, punched to deep point for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched towards covers for a single.
Too full outside off, Lahiru comes right forward and drives it through covers for a single.
Fuller around off, played back to the bowler.
Fuller outside off, Chamara comes forward a tad and drives it through covers for a single.
Nudges one towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Shorter around middle, goes back and works it behind square leg for a single.
Fuller around off, turned through mid on for a single.
Worked towards square leg for a run by Thirimanne.
Fuller around off, pushed towards covers by Thirimanne.
A tad short around off, punched to long on for a single.
Flatter around middle, punched towards mid on for a single. Kapugedera was ball-watching but since the fielder at mid on was slow, no harm done.
Kapugedera comes forward and blocks it.
Bowls the googly around off, Thirimanne does not expect it for some reason, punches it in the air just wide of mid-wicket for a single to get off the mark.
Lahiru Thirimanne walks out to bat.

OUT! Tharanga holes out! Shorter in length by Shadab, Upul goes for the pull but gets a top edge. The ball flies safely into the hands of Zaman at deep square leg. Two for Khan and he is again among the wickets. A disappointing end to Tharanga's innings which promised a lot more.
WIDE! Flatter down the leg side, Tharanga cannot clip it. The keeper fumbles, cannot appeal. The umpire signals a wide.
Too full on middle and leg, turned towards mid-wicket by Tharanga.
Loops it outside off, pushed through covers for a single where Hafeez does not quite do his best.
Lunges forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
Turns it through backward square leg for a run.
FOUR! In the air...but safe! Fuller outside off, Kapugedera kneels down and goes for the sweep. He gets a top edge which falls safely in the long leg region. First boundary since the 12th over!
Shorter outside off, punched to the left of the bowler.
Around off and middle, Kapugedera turns it towards mid-wicket.
Lands it around off, played back to the bowler.
Takes a single with a push towards covers.
Chamara punches it towards point from his crease.
Stays on his back foot and defends it.
Fuller around off, turned towards mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Shorter outside off, defended back down the wicket.
Chamara Kapugedera comes in to bat.

OUT! Shadab has his man! Bowls another googly around off and middle, Chandimal prods forward to defend but is hit on his pads. The players appeal and the umpire rules it out. Chandimal is not sure of the inside edge and hence has a word with his partner before taking the review. No edge confirmed by the Ultra Edge. Ball Tracker shows three reds and hence Chandimal has to go back. He has been dismissed by Shadab Khan's googly twice in as many games. His poor run in ODIs continue, his SR of 38 does not help his side either. Both sides have now lost their reviews.
A review taken by Chandimal. Only an inside edge can save him there as this one looks plumb.
Comes down the wicket and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Lands it around off, turned towards mid-wicket by Chandimal. That kept a touch low.
Chandimal gets in line and defends it.
Turns it through the leg side for a single.
Flatter around off and middle, Tharanga shapes to punch but gets a soft leading edge towards covers.
Chandimal kneels down and turns it through backward square leg for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez is into the attack. He was only given one over earlier.

NOT OUT! A spike saves Chandimal! Shadab bowls the googly around off, Chandimal kneels down to sweep but is hit on his pads. The fielders are confident but the umpire says no. Khan is pretty sure and Sarfraz does not need anything more. He goes for the review. That was precisely how Khan had asked for a review in the Champions Trophy Final in 2017 against Yuvraj Singh. This looks pretty plumb too. Ultra Edge shows that there is a slight spike as the ball went past the bat. That was pretty close. Pakistan lose a review.
Review time! Pakistan have taken a review for an LBW against Chandimal. Shadab Khan seems pretty confident and he wants it to be reviewed.
Full toss on the pads, turned through mid-wicket for a single. Should have put it away.
Slight delay due to the sightscreen!
Fuller outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Fuller around off, Chandimal comes forward and blocks it.
Fuller around the pads, turned towards mid-wicket. The keeper appeals for no reason. Leg bye taken in that time.
Floats it around middle, Tharanga lunges forward to turn it through but almost lobs it to mid-wicket.
Shorter outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.
Good length around off, comes in, Chandimal cannot clip it through. The ball goes off the pads to third man for a leg bye.
Fuller around off, Upul pushes it towards mid off and takes off. Zaman is not quick and fumbles which allows the single. Sarfraz is not happy.
Tharanga mistimes his drive towards covers.
Fuller around off, turned towards mid-wicket.
Angles a good length ball around off, tapped towards covers. The throw is a wild one at the bowler's end but Hafeez does well to stop it from going through.
CLOSE! Shadab bowls the googly outside off, Chandimal shapes to cut but is beaten by the pace on that one. That was pretty close to being caught behind. Shadab cannot believe it.
Fuller on middle, turned through mid on for a single.
Flatter around off, nudged towards mid-wicket by the batsman.
Drives it through mid off for a couple of runs.
Flatter down the leg side, Tharanga cannot clip it. The keeper takes it and appeals for some reason. Maybe to put off the umpire, no wide signaled so job done.
Floats it around off, Tharanga turns it towards mid-wicket.
Slants it around middle, turned through backward square leg for a single.
Fuller outside off, pushes back to the bowler. Ashraf mimes the throw.
Full and outside off, driven wide of the cover fielder for a single.
Back of a length again, Chandimal can only find point with another dab. He is on 14 from 38 balls, poor stuff.
Fuller in length outside off, driven to covers from the crease.
Back of a length outside off, tapped towards point by Chandimal.
Fuller around middle, clipped through mid on for a single.
Gets one to come into the batsman, Chandimal blocks it nicely.
Shorter outside off, Chandimal goes back and cuts it hard towards backward point.
Works it with the spin for a single towards mid-wicket.
Flatter around off, nudged towards square leg for a single.

Well played, Upul! Full toss around off, Tharanga slaps it to long off for a single. That also brings up his 35th ODI fifty. He has been in superb touch and has made most of the chances. He will want to carry on the good work.
Good length outside off, Upul opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a run.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it on off. Tharanga plays it towards point.
Angles it into the pads, Chandimal flicks it through square leg for a run.
Very full on off, Dinesh can't find the gap as he drives it straight to mid off.
Good length on off, Dinesh guides it to point.
Fullish ball on off, Chandimal drives it to mid off.
Drags his length back outside off. Chandimal cuts it through point for a run.
Leg spinner on middle, Tharanga let's the ball do it's bit and then flicks it through square leg for a run.
Another full toss to Chandimal, second in this over. Dinesh drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on the pads, Tharanga flicks it through the leg side for an easy single.
A full toss on off, Chandimal drives it down to long off for a run.
Flicks it with the spin through square leg for a run.
Shadab Khan into the attack. He bowled really well in the last game. Can he do the same?
Short again but outside off. Chandimal easily lets it through to the keeper.
Good stuff! A short one followed by a yorker on middle. Chandimal does well to dig it out.
Back of a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the back foot.
Off cutter on off, comes in sharply. Chandimal adjusts and flicks it towards backward square leg. Good running by the two helps them take two.
Just ahead of a length on off, Chandimal drives it to the man at covers.
Good length on off, Tharanga drives it on the up through cover-point for a run.
Fullish ball on off, Chandimal drives it to mid off.
Full on the pads. Tharanga clips it through square leg. There is protection in the deep so it is just a single.
Fuller in length this time. Tharanga drives it back to the bowler.
Just short of a length on off, not quite there for the pull. Tharanga still goes for it but gets beaten.
Good length on off, Chandimal taps it towards covers and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Errs in line and drifts it down the leg side. Tharanga flicks it to fine leg for a run.
Drinks! A good start for Sri Lanka here but a wicket and some good overs before drinks has not put the game in balance.
Short again on off, Chandimal hops and defends it.
Once again good fielding by Pakistan! Hasan bowls it fullish in length on off. Chandimal drives it towards cover where Hafeez dives to his left and makes a good stop.
Fuller in length on off, Chandimal drives it to covers.
Back of a length on off, Dinesh pushes it towards point where the fielder makes a good diving stop to his right.
Lands it on a length outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for a run.
Comes around the wicket to the left hander and bangs it in short, Tharanga watchfully ducks under it.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Length ball outside off, Chandimal shoulders arms to it.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.

Bowls it on middle, Tharanga walks across and flicks it through backward square leg. They set off for a run. The fielder in the deep runs towards the ball and misfields but recovers well and does not concede a second. Tharanga wanted another but Chandimal sent him back.
Fuller in length on middle, Tharanga flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off. Tharanga tries to drag his pull through the leg side but gets it off the bottom half to mid off.
Fahim Ashraf comes into the attack for the first time in this series.
Back of a length on off. Chandimal defends it towards covers.
Hasan Ali bends his back there! He bangs it in short and the ball also skids off the surface. Chandimal awkwardly ducks under it.
Back of a length on off, Chandimal defends it from within the crease.
Good length on off, Chandimal prods forward in defense.
Lands it on a length on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Short and on middle, Tharanga pulls it through square leg for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length on off. Chandimal defends it solidly.
Fuller in length outside off, Upul drives it through the off side for a run.

Good length on off, jags back in sharply. Chandimal gets an inside edge as he tries to defend it towards fine leg for a run. This was a similar delivery to which Chandimal got out to in the first ODI.
FOUR!  A classy shot to get off the mark! Raees bowls it fuller in length. It tails back into the batsman. Chandimal flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Raees continues! He bowls it fuller outside off, Tharanga plays it through the off side for a run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Dinesh Chandimal is the next man in. He has been promoted up the order in this game.

OUT! KABOOM! The breakthrough-bowler has done it! That one stayed low but Hasan won't mind. He lands it on a length outside off, Dickwella goes for a loose drive with the bat away from his body. He gets an inside edge onto his back pad in attempting the shot as the ball goes on to rattle the middle stump. Hasan Ali is pumped and why wouldn't he be. He has now also equaled Liam Plunkett and Rashid Khan as the highest wicket-taker in 2017 in ODIs.
An off cutter on middle, Niroshan flicks it towards mid on.
FOUR! SMART! Hasan bangs it in short outside off, sits up to be hit. Dickwella plays the upper cut over the slip fielder's head for a boundary.
Fuller outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for a run.
Good length outside off, Dickwella guides it down to third man for a run.
Just one over for spin! Hasan Ali is into the attack.
Fullish ball flicked to mid on.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.

A mix up but no harm done! Raees bowls it shorter in length outside off. Tharanga pushes it towards zaman at cover-point. He sets off for a run but Zaman is quick to the ball. Seeing that, Dickwella sends him back from half way. Fakhar steadies himself but fires a wild throw which misses the stump from quite a bit. Tharanga will breathe a sigh of relief as if there was a direct hit, there he would have been a goner.
Similar length but outside off. Upul leaves it.
Lovely, lovely bowling! He goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman and gets it to shape away. Tharanga pokes at it and gets beaten.
Very good batting, very good running also! Raees lands it on a length around off, Dickwella taps it towards covers for a run.
FOUR! Pristine! Hafeez floats it outside off, Tharanga lunges forward and drives it crisply through covers for a majestic boundary. Superb shot!
Flatter around off, Dickwella shapes to defend but gets it off the inside edge towards square leg for a single.
This time Tharanga comes down and nudges one towards short fine leg for a single.
Quicker one around leg, expecting the charge, Tharanga goes nowhere and leaves it. The umpire does not wide it for some reason. Upul is not impressed one bit.
Loops it around off, Tharanga drives it towards mid off.
Dickwella comes forward and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Time for some spin! Mohammad Hafeez comes on for a bowl.
Full and outside off, a handsome drive from Tharanga finds the cover fielder.
Good length outside off, dabbed through backward point for a single.

The white ball is being looked at. The umpires are not happy with one of them and hence are getting it changed. The umpire is trying to rough the ball up, by throwing it on the dry areas on the surface.
Shorter in length around off, pulled through mid-wicket. Both Tharanga and Dickwella are quick enough to take three runs.
Length ball around off, worked towards mid-wicket by the Sri Lankan captain.
A tad short around off, tucked towards mid-wicket.
Full and outside off, Tharanga mistimes his clip towards mid on from his crease. The mid on fielder fumbles but does not concede any run.
WIDE! Shorter in length around middle and leg, Tharanga ducks under it. The umpire signals it one for the over. The Pakistan skipper is not happy though, he never is.
Full and wide outside off, driven towards covers by Dickwella.
Shorter in length outside off, Dickwella pulls it over mid-wicket. Imam-ul-Haq gives it a chase and then stops it from going through. Two runs taken.
Fuller in length, pushed towards the bowler from the crease.
One for the over! Short one outside off, Dickwella first aims to ramp it but then spots that the bounce is too high. Leaves it. One for the over signaled.
Edged! Tharanga shapes to drive to this full length ball but gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Good length outside off, left alone by Tharanga.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Fuller in length and down the leg side. Tharanaga misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide. Sarfraz is not a happy man. He gives a stare to Raees.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it into the batsman. Tharanaga flicks it to the man at mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Tharanga lets it be.
In the air.... but safe! Raees bowls it on a length outside off. Dickwella tries for the paddle again but gets a top edge which lands safe towards square leg for a run.
WIDE! Errs in line and drifts it down the leg side. Dickwella misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Fuller in length outside off, Tharanga drives it through covers for three.

Dickwella is getting a little over ambitious here! He goes down on one knee and tries to attempt a paddle. Raees bowls a very good slower delivery outside off. Dickwella misses and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire remains put. The batsman sneak a leg bye as the ball rolls on the leg side.
FOUR! Best of the lot! This was beautiful! Fullish ball on off by Junaid. Tharanga times it to perfection through the covers for another boundary. Second off the over and also 10 from it.
Good length on off, Tharanga drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Bad ball and dispatched! Short and wide outside off by Junaid. Tharanga's eyes lit up as soon as  he saw width. He cuts it hard through backward point for a boundary.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman.
Drifts it on the pads, Tharanga flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Shorter in length outside off. Tharanga cuts it to point.
One shot too many! He tries dancing down the track and slashes at the ball outside off but misses. A good over for the Lankans. 9 runs from it.

FOUR! WOW! Ruman Raees will not be expecting that! That almost went all the way! A length ball on middle by Raees. Dickwella lofts it over mid on and gets a boundary. It did not come off the middle but still cleared the fielder by a long way.
Wide enough for the batsman to not play at it.
Clips it with the angle through mid-wicket but not with the grace of the last shot but enough to fetch a single.

FOUR! Too easy! He is in form and this is not the line you want to bowl to him! Fuller in length on the pads, a batsman of Tharanga's caliber won't miss out there. He flicks it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fullish ball on off, Tharanga drives it back to the bowler.

Very full ball on off, Dickwella drives it off the bottom half of the bat towards the bowler. He fields it and fires a wayward throw back towards the batsman which is collected by the first slip fielder. It must have slipped out of his hands.
Fullish ball on off, Niroshan times it to covers.
Back of a length on off, no width on offer. Dickwella defends it solidly.
Just ahead of a length on off. Tharanga pushes it towards short covers. The fielder makes a half stop and the batsmen take a single.
Good length on off. Tharanga drives it to covers.

FOUR! First boundary of the day! Khan bowls it a little short outside off, gives Tharanga width. Upul just loves it there, he waits for it and punches it past the diving cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Fuller in length on off, inviting the batsman to drive. He does so but straight to the cover fielder.
Very full in length also some swing away from the batsman. Tharanga tries to dig it out but gets an outside edge to third man for a run.
Length on off, Tharanga defends it off the front foot.
Full again around off, looking for some swing but there isn't any. Tharanga leans into it and drives it through cover-point. Imam-ul-Haq there gives it a chase, slides and keeps it down to two.
Good length, shapes away from the batsman around off. Dickwella pushes it towards cover-point. The fielder there fumbles and allows a single.
Starts off with a fuller length delivery, outside off, swings further away. Dickwella opts not to fiddle at it. We did not see any swing in the first over but Raees did get some on his first ball.
Ruman Raees to bowl with the second new ball. One slip in place for him.
Bowls it on a length outside off. Tharanga lets it be. A tight first over by Junaid.
Back of a length on off, Upul punches it to the man at cover-point. A good confident shot off the back foot.
Fuller in length this time, wobbled seam but outside off. Tharanga who is fresh of a hundred in the last game shoulders his arms to it.
Sri Lanka are away! Dickwella gets off the mark! Khan lands it on a length outside off, Dickwella guides it down to third man for a run.
Length ball, this time closer to the off stump. Dickwella tries to drive but gets a bottom edge besides the wicket.
Starts off with a delivery outside off, no swing on offer. Dickwella does not need to play at it and he lets it go. A loosener by Khan to start off with.

We are all set to get underway. The men who matter are out in the middle. Upul Tharanga, the skipper, and Niroshan Dickwella will open the batting for Sri Lanka. A good start is what they will be hoping for. Junaid Khan will bowl with the first new ball for Pakistan. He has two slips in place.

TOSS - Sri Lanka win the toss and for a change they are going to bat first. There are two changes for them Dushmantha Chameera and Chamara Kapugedera come in for Kusal Mendis and Suranga Lakmal. For Pakistan, they have a youngster making his debut and as mentioned in the text above it is Imam-ul-Haq in place of Ahmed Shehzad. Fahim Ashraf comes in for the injured Imad Wasim.

Hello and welcome to the 3rd ODI between Pakistan and Sri Lanka in Abu Dhabi. Nothing seems to be going the visitors' way and Tharanga would hope things change today. It is a must-win situation for them if they are to stay alive in the series. It would be interesting to see if there are some changes made in the batting line-up as it has failed to deliver the goods. The home side on the other hand, have only one issue and that is the form of Ahmed Shehzad who might find himself on the bench. Imam-ul-Haq, the youngster, shall replace him. Their morale would be high heading into the game and Sarfraz would hope for another win today. Will we see Sri Lanka turning the tide or will the plot remain the same? Toss and teams coming up in a while.
